These audits include inventories of County Geological Sites (CGSs), which are the best examples of given geological themes in each county. To explore county geological site data, please visit the dedicated page . Audited sites refer to CGSs in those counties which have undergone the County Geological Heritage Audit process, when CGS status is officially conferred. Detailed site visits and boundary definition forms part of this auditing process. Audited sites are marked in pink on our webviewer. Unaudit
